state.paragraph: On November 3, 2014, the board met in person, together with members of management and representatives of J.P. Morgan and Wachtell Lipton, to continue its review of strategic alternatives, including a review of the indications of interest. The board determined to allow the four bidders that had indicated a price or range at or above $80.00 per share to proceed to the final round of the sale process. Following this meeting, representatives of J.P. Morgan notified the eliminated parties, none of which indicated any interest or ability to remain in the process at price levels above their respective initial indications.

ledger_rows.Note: Preliminary non-binding IOI; range. Consortium led by BC Partners funds (later with CDPQ, GIC, StepStone). Terms beyond price not reported.
Preliminary non-binding IOI; range. Advanced 11/03; on recommended reading, later part of Bidder 3.
Third of three IOIs whose range “reached at least $80.00”; endpoints not disclosed, so price cells blank. Advanced 11/03; on recommended reading, later part of Bidder 3.
Preliminary non-binding IOI at a point price.
Six IOIs in total; the remaining two, prices undisclosed but below the $80.00 cut-off (inferred from the board’s advancement rule). Reasons section says IOIs came from 5 bidder groups.
15 signers − 6 submitters = 9. J.P. Morgan heard their rationales for not submitting (10/30–11/02); rationales not disclosed. Would be 10 if only 5 IOIs (Q4).
Revises #19 after J.P. Morgan calls on rationales for price levels; raised $78.00 to a range, bringing it above the $80.00 cut-off.

Board advanced four bidders at or above $80.00 (Buyer Group, Bidder 2, Unnamed financial bidders 1 and 2) to the “final round”; November diligence, management presentations, updated FY2014 projections for all.
Below board’s $80.00 cut-off; notified after the meeting. None indicated interest or ability to go above its initial indication.

Ad hoc committee let two bidders work together: one (final-round invitee) wanted an equity partner given deal size; other would drop out otherwise. Members inferred as bidders 1 and 2. Count = net reduction.

exit.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a potential buyer withdraws, declines to bid, is told it will not advance, or is otherwise excluded from the process. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.

adviser.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a financial or legal adviser is retained, engaged, terminated or first shown acting for the target, a committee or a bidder. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
